# proxmox_qemu_cloudinit_dump (Data Source)

Dumps generated cloud-init data through `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/cloudinit/dump`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_cloudinit_dump" "c" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
  type = "user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `type` (String) `user`, `network` or `meta`.
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String)
